hero.title: Nhyehyɛe
hero.subtitle: Ahwehwɛde, amanneɛbɔ, ɔman ne kasa, ne abusua kwan tiawa.

familySection.guest: Hyɛn mu na hyehyɛ wo abusua profile, mma, ne ɔwarefo nkitahodie.
familySection.hint: Fa mma ka ho na fa wo ɔwarefo ka ho. Awofoɔ biara sie ne CareMate data ankasa.

location.title: Beaeɛ
location.guestHint: Hyɛn mu na hyehyɛ wo ɔman ne kasa. Ahɔhoɔ de mfiase paw di dwuma.
location.hint: Wɔde di dwuma ma mpɔtam apɔwmuden nsɛm ne kasa apɛdeɛ.
location.searchEmpty: Ɔman biara nni hɔ a ɛne nhwehwɛmu no hyia.
